title: Anchorage
description: Institutional crypto-bank dark: a pure black page, near-white text, charcoal-to-black panels, one cobalt blue for buttons, stat labels and link hovers, and a sparing lilac for hairline rings and gradient ends. Big soft blue glows bloom out of the black. A geometric-leaning grotesque for headings over Inter body at medium weight. Light sibling: cool paper-grey page, white panels, black text, the same cobalt.
notes: Hanken Grotesk stands in for the original's ES Rebond Grotesque (closed); Inter is the original's own body face
card is the top of the panel gradient (cards fade from card to background)
secondary is the lifted near-black of the contact section; muted is a form field on it
highlight is the lilac; chart-2 is the success green of check marks
